summary: Timeout semantics: global timeout defaults to 0 (none); a negative template timeout means truly no timeout, 0 uses the global value, positive sets it. Also Show Changes and Instance Groups (in preference order; prompting overrides organization and inventory instance groups; container groups need admin rights).
questions: How do I disable the timeout on a job template?
What does a timeout of 0 mean on a job template?
How are job template instance groups ordered?
Who can use container groups in job templates?

answer_card.title: Job template timeout values
answer_card.answer_md:
| Template timeout | Effect |
|---|---|
| `< 0` | no timeout at all |
| `0` | use the global timeout (default `0` = none) |
| `> 0` | cancel after N seconds |
